official_page_observation: The current first-party homepage identifies Anson General Hospital at 101 Avenue J, Anson, TX 79501 and links Price Transparency to the hospital-specific Boomi flow.
browser_observation: The permitted browser rendered the provider disclaimer and a Standard Charges selector listing Anson General Hospital and Anson Family Wellness Clinic. The Anson General Hospital row exposed Tall CSV and Wide CSV controls; activating Tall CSV opened a Box-hosted download response, but this client did not expose the downloaded bytes or a stable direct MRF URL for bounded identity and metadata validation.
pointer_observation: Direct browser retrieval of https://ansongeneralhospital.com/cms-hpt.txt and /.well-known/cms-hpt.txt was not accessible through this client.
interpretation: This narrows the discovery gap and confirms a current first-party pricing portal with a facility-specific standard-charges control, but it is not evidence of the file's identity, schema or freshness. No third-party or sibling file was assigned and no compliance conclusion was inferred.
next_action: Capture the Box download bytes or a stable direct file URL through an interactive browser/download-capable client, then validate facility name, address, state, NPI/license, CMS version, last_updated_on and attestation before promotion.
